summary: git_archive and the diff/blob scans honor repository-local refs/replace, so the archived tree can differ from the attested commit OID.
failure_scenario: A checkout with `git replace <candidate-oid> <other>`: _resolved_commit_oid returns the original OID, git archive <oid> packages the replacement's tree; gate records original OID/diff hash for different bytes. _require_no_local_attributes guards info/attributes but nothing guards refs/replace; no --no-replace-objects (other modules such as candidate_source_archive_oracle.py already use it).
evidence: Scratch repo, git 2.43.0: replaced commit 2 with commit 1; `git archive --format=tar <oid2>` extracted f.txt='good' while `git --no-replace-objects show <oid2>:f.txt`='evil'. Runtime git call pattern read at release_gate.py:316-340; full gate not run.

summary: canonical_candidate_diff_sha256 baseline-range diff uses `-O <file> A..B`, which git 2.43.0 rejects with exit 129, so the gate raises CalledProcessError.
failure_scenario: Linux host with git 2.43.0 and a baseline commit: `git diff ... -O /dev/null <base>..<head>` prints 'Not a git repository ... --no-index' and exits 129; digest never produced; tests exercising the baseline path fail on that git.
evidence: Reproduced the exact flag form (separate -O /dev/null plus A..B) on local git 2.43.0 in a scratch repo: exit 129. Did not run the test suite (deps not installed); CI git version unconfirmed.

summary: _require_clean_tracked_state honors repo-local core.fileMode=false, so a mode-changed tracked file passes as clean (ls-files -v flag guard exists but does not cover this).
failure_scenario: Candidate checkout with .git/config core.fileMode=false and a chmod +x on a tracked file: status --porcelain is empty, candidate identity issued for a worktree differing from HEAD.
evidence: Scratch repo: chmod +x f.txt showed ' M f.txt'; after `git config core.fileMode false` status was empty. Other local keys (fsmonitor etc.) not tested.

summary: candidate_dirty check trusts plain git status/ls-files under repo-local config and index flags, so an edited tracked file can look clean; no ls-files -v hidden-flag check (task13 has one).
failure_scenario: Tracked .py edited after `git update-index --assume-unchanged` (or skip-worktree) or status.showUntrackedFiles=no: status returns '' and verify_runtime proceeds against a non-pinned tree. HEAD^{tree} also honors refs/replace.
evidence: Scratch repo: assume-unchanged + edit -> empty `git status --porcelain`. setup_lookup_backend.py grep shows only an ls-files --others check at line 270, no hidden-flag guard. Replace part not separately run.

summary: installed_hermes_identity uses plain git status with ambient env/local config, so index-flagged modified tracked files report baseline:true for the pinned commit.
failure_scenario: Pinned Hermes cache with a modified tracked file flagged assume-unchanged/skip-worktree: no refusal, identity {commit: pinned, baseline: true}; gate evidence bound to commit not describing executed bytes.
evidence: Same git semantics reproduced in scratch repo (assume-unchanged hides edit from status); real_gate_support grep shows no ls-files -v guard. Real Hermes cache not exercised.

summary: _git_archive hashes an archive influenced by repo-local .git/info/attributes and .git/config (export-ignore, eol, tar.umask); the double-run equality check cannot detect it.
failure_scenario: info/attributes 'x.py export-ignore' or 'eol=crlf' changes archive bytes for same HEAD; sha256 becomes candidate.sourceArchiveSha256 though not the committed tree. Only core.hooksPath/fsmonitor pinned; unlike release_gate there is no _require_no_local_attributes or core.attributesFile override.
evidence: Source read at 948-975 confirms flags/env; grep finds no attributes guard in the file. Archive-variation mechanics follow standard git behavior (export-ignore/eol honored by git archive); I did not re-run the variants, producer not run end to end.

summary: Earlier allegations about companion/host, foreground, _speech_text and edge_tts are outside the assigned files and were not reviewed. release_gate._require_no_local_attributes already guards info/attributes for git_archive and diff; task13 already rejects ls-files -v hidden flags.
